items.title: Steve Buckingham, interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, February 25, 2019 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: I’ve got pictures Mr. Hammond gave me of John Hammond leading a section. It was Benny Goodman; Freddie Green, Basie’s guitarist; Basie playing piano; Buck Clayton playing trumpet.

ctx.x: I’ve got pictures Mr. Hammond gave me of John Hammond leading a section. It was Benny Goodman; Freddie Green, Basie’s guitarist; Basie playing piano; Buck Clayton playing trumpet. It was an integrated band. But Goodman, John Hammond told me, Goodman couldn’t let other people know about that. Otherwise the band would be banned for integrating, behind the scenes. They played up in Harlem at nights, and places in LA. They were jamming. Especially in Harlem. But it was in ’35 when Hammond convinced Benny to hire…
This could be an impossible question but as we wrap up here, you are at a cocktail party and you mention this course you teach and someone asks you well what makes black music black music?
